mapper.select: select l.id, l.honor_record_id as honorRecordId, l.team_id as teamId, l.player_id as playerId, l.member_id as memberId, ifnull(nullif(p.game_nickname, ''), mp.nickname) as playerName, l.role_type as roleType, l.jersey_no as jerseyNo, l.position_code as positionCode, l.sort_no as sortNo, af.access_url as avatarUrl from basket_honor_lineup l left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = l.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = l.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset af on af.id = mp.avatar_file_id and af.is_delete = 0 where l.honor_record_id = #{honorRecordId} and l.is_delete = 0 order by l.sort_no, l.id
mapper.update: update basket_honor_lineup set is_delete = 1, update_time = now() where honor_record_id = #{honorRecordId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into basket_honor_lineup ( honor_record_id, team_id, player_id, member_id, role_type, jersey_no, position_code, sort_no, create_time, update_time, is_delete ) values
(#{item.honorRecordId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.playerId}, #{item.memberId}, #{item.roleType}, #{item.jerseyNo}, #{item.positionCode}, #{item.sortNo}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.isDelete})
